newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk, Ventspils remain closed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk, Ventspils remain closed - trade.

text.p: The Black Sea port of Novorossiisk, Russia's leading oil export terminal, remained shut on Wednesday because of high winds and swell after reopening for only three hours on Tuesday, a shipping source said.
Novorossiisk opened at 1230 local time on Tuesday and closed three hours later due a heavy swell. It had closed on Monday due to strong swells.
Bad weather has kept the port closed for much of February, leading to loading delays of about five days, traders said.
Latvia's Ventspils terminal on the Baltic remained closed on Wednesday. It closed at midday on Tuesday due to strong winds.
Other Black Sea oil ports at Odessa and Tuapse were operating normally.
